# javaabu/dynamic-menubuilder

> Menus admins build by drag and drop, for Laravel. Developers define menu locations (Menus::location('header')->maxDepth(2)) and what items can link to: custom links, records of MenuLinkable models and their index pages, registered as sources (Menus::linkable(Page::class)). Route::menus() registers the builder pages, rendered in Blade (javaabu/forms) or Inertia React (@javaabu/forms + Onu), with overridable controllers and a javaabu/permissions policy. Menus render with <x-dynamic-menubuilder::menu location="header" /> or <Menu location="header" /> from @javaabu/dynamic-menubuilder (Inertia shared data). With javaabu/translatable (optional), item titles and URLs are translated and the structure is shared by every language. Dhivehi and RTL built in.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/dynamic-menubuilder/.

## Rules

- Define locations and linkable sources in a service provider's `boot()` (or `config/dynamic-menubuilder.php` `locations` / `linkables`). Never hard-code a site menu in a layout when the app has this package; render the location instead.
- Render with `<x-dynamic-menubuilder::menu location="header" />` (Blade) or `<Menu location="header" />` (React, after adding the location to `config('dynamic-menubuilder.share')`). An unknown location throws; a location without a menu renders nothing.
- Make models linkable with `implements MenuLinkable` + `use IsMenuLinkable` and write `getMenuLinkUrl(?string $locale)`. Override `getMenuLinkTitleColumn()` for a `name` column, `isMenuLinkVisible()` to hide drafts, and `getMenuLinkIndexUrl()` for an index page. Then `Menus::linkable(Model::class, 'key')`.
- One model with several types (posts with a `type` column) is several sources: `Menus::linkable(Post::class, 'news')->query(fn ($q) => $q->where('type', 'news'))->indexUrl(...)`. Source keys are stored on items: never rename them.
- Register the builder with `Route::menus(['prefix' => 'admin/menus', 'guard' => …])` inside the app's admin middleware group. Nothing registers routes automatically. Run `php artisan permissions:sync` for `view_menus`, `edit_menus`, `delete_menus`.
- Depth: a location's `maxDepth()` limits the builder and the rendering. A menu in several locations is limited by the shallowest.
- Who sees a menu on the site is the location's `can()` and each item's visibility (everyone/guests/users of the location's guard), not the menus permissions.
- Save menus in code with `MenuTree::sync($menu, $items)`: a flat list in tree order, each item naming its `parent` key. Assign locations with `$menu->assignLocations([...])` or `Menus::assign('header', $menu)`.
- With javaabu/translatable, item fields are `title_{locale}` and `url_{locale}`; there's one structure for all languages. Limit an item to languages with `locales`.
- Override the controller with `config('dynamic-menubuilder.controllers.menus')`, the policy with `config('permissions.policies')` or `Gate::policy(Menu::class, …)`, the form by extending `MenuForm`.
- Every user-facing string goes through `__('dynamic-menubuilder::strings.…')` with a Dhivehi line. Use logical CSS (`ms-`, `margin-inline-start`) and Thaana in tests.
